activity.notes: Kuniwo Nakamura served two consecutive presidential terms from January 1993 through January 2001. Palauan government and national museum sources sometimes label these by election/calendar years as 1992–2000 or January 1993–January 2001; ATLAS uses the inauguration-month framing from the Belau National Museum.

sources.title: President's Exhibit — Belau National Museum
sources.citation_text: The Belau National Museum lists President Kuniwo Nakamura's two terms as January 1993–January 1997 and January 1997–January 2001.
